closing: The rule decided on its own: a definition containing no cost and no resistance-carrier keeps its shape by the even-count clause. The only discretion was refusing to invent partners for capacity and bandwidth, which the frozen vocabulary withholds; that does not touch the keeps call.

physical: Data processing inequality — Processing cannot increase information: if Z depends on X only through Y, then the information Z carries about X is at most what Y carries. I(X;Z) ≤ I(X;Y). Form: inequality.
reflected_sentence: The bound keeps its shape: what the last in a chain can say about the first never exceeds what the middle can say — stated in plain words, because this carried-aboutness has no partner in the frozen vocabulary.
rule_reason: the limit (at-most) is set by the ordering of dependence X to Y to Z, not by any resistance-carrying quantity; no resistance-cost and no separation, zero (even) keeps the shape
unmapped_terms: the chain of dependence X -> Y -> Z
interpretation: Nothing crosses. The bound keeps its shape in silence.
closing: An inequality looks like a limit, and limits caused by resistance turn, so I checked what sets this bound. It is set by the dependence structure, and mutual information is pre-decided as a measure, not resistance. The fixed table made that check mechanical, so no judgment call was needed on the shape.

physical: Landauer's principle — Erasing one bit of information dissipates at least k T ln 2 of energy as heat; logically irreversible operations have a thermodynamic cost that rises with temperature. E ≥ k × T × ln 2. Form: inequality.
reflected_formula: E ≥ k × T × ln 2 (shape kept; only E crosses, k and T have no partner)
reflected_sentence: The inequality keeps its shape: E is shared by both sides, and each act of wiping a mark still demands at least a fixed share of E, a share that grows with the warmth of the surroundings — the warmth and the constant having no partner to carry them across, they are named here only in plain words.
rule_reason: the one listed cost rises with temperature, and the pre-run table fixes temperature as not carrying resistance; a cost not caused by resistance does not count, so the count is zero (even) and the shape keeps
interpretation: E crosses, being the one energy shared by both sides. The share keeps its shape. The measure of that share has no partner and stays silent.
closing: The costs field listed a cost that rises with temperature, which at first looks like a turn signal, but the fixed quantity table declares temperature non-resistance, so by the rule as written the cost does not count and the inequality keeps. Had I judged heat dissipation itself resistance-like, it would have turned; I did not make that judgment because the table pre-empted it. That is why confidence is 6 rather than 7.

physical: Shannon entropy — The uncertainty of a source is minus the sum over outcomes of probability times log probability; it is the least average number of bits needed to encode it. H = −Σ p × log p. Form: definition.
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps its shape: the uncertainty of a source weighs each outcome against its likelihood and sums them — stated in plain words, since neither the uncertainty-measure nor likelihood has a partner, and the map row for entropy was not extended to this separate quantity.
rule_reason: definition with no listed cost and no resistance-carrying quantity (Shannon entropy and probability are both fixed as non-resistance); zero costs keeps the shape
unmapped_terms: Shannon entropy (the frozen table maps only 'entropy'; I did not extend the row)
interpretation: Nothing crosses. The shape keeps in silence.
closing: The shape was mechanical: a definition with no costs keeps. The one open question was vocabulary, not shape — whether 'entropy -> Culmination (provisional)' covers Shannon entropy. The pre-run quantity list deliberately separates the two, so I recorded Shannon entropy unmapped rather than guess; that discretion does not affect the keeps call.

physical: Boltzmann entropy — The entropy of a macrostate is Boltzmann's constant times the logarithm of the number of microstates that realize it. S = k × ln W. Form: definition.
reflected_formula: Culmination (provisional) = k × ln W (only the left-hand name crosses; k and W have no partner)
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps its shape: S reflects as Culmination (provisional), which grows with the logarithm of the count of ways a state can be realized — but a count is a number, numbers do not cross, and the constant has no partner, so only the name survives the mirror and the rest is plain words.
rule_reason: definition with no listed cost; entropy, microstate count and the Boltzmann constant are all fixed as non-resistance; zero (even) count keeps

closing: The rule decided alone: a definition with zero costs keeps its shape. No judgment was needed; the thinness of the reflection comes from missing partners and from the no-numbers clause, not from any doubt about the shape.

physical: Equipartition — In thermal equilibrium every quadratic degree of freedom carries an average energy of half k times the temperature. ⟨E⟩ = ½ × k × T per degree of freedom. Form: identity.
reflected_formula: ⟨E⟩ = ½ × k × T (shape kept; only E crosses; ½, k, T and per-degree have no partner)
reflected_sentence: The identity keeps its shape: E is shared by both sides, and every open way a system can hold E receives an equal share — the size of that share, a half of a constant times the warmth, has no partner and its number does not cross, so it is said in plain words.
rule_reason: an identity with no cost and no resistance-carrier (energy, temperature, degrees of freedom, Boltzmann constant all non-resistance); identities keep their shape
interpretation: E crosses, being the one energy. The equal sharing keeps its shape. The size of each share stays behind, having no partner.
closing: The rule's first clause names identities explicitly as keepers, so the shape was decided without judgment. The reflection is nearly empty only because every term except E lacks a partner.

physical: Ergodic hypothesis — For an ergodic system the long-time average of an observable equals its average over the ensemble of accessible states. No formula. Form: identity.
reflected_sentence: The identity keeps its shape: with time reflected as Expansion, the average taken along Expansion and the average taken across all reachable states remain one and the same — what is averaged, and the reachable states themselves, have no partner and are described in plain words.
rule_reason: the statement asserts the equality of two averages, an identity, and identities keep their shape; no cost and no resistance-carrier appears
interpretation: Expansion crosses where time stood. The two averages stay one. What is averaged has no partner and stays behind.
closing: The identity clause decided the shape on its own. The small discretion was letting the time -> Expansion row apply to the phrase 'long-time average'; that is a direct row application and does not bear on keeps. Confidence is 6 because the reflection is thin, not because the shape was in doubt.

physical: Fluctuation-dissipation theorem — The way a system in equilibrium dissipates a small push is fixed by the spectrum of its own spontaneous fluctuations: friction and thermal noise are two faces of one quantity. No formula. Form: identity.
reflected_sentence: The identity keeps its shape: friction reflects as resonance, and resonance and a system's own spontaneous trembling remain two faces of one quantity, as the drain on a nudge and the hiss of equilibrium were on the physical side — drain, nudge and hiss having no partners, they stand in plain words.
rule_reason: the statement is an identity — 'two faces of one quantity' — and the rule's first clause says identities keep their shape regardless of the resistance their terms carry
unmapped_terms: damping coefficient (a resistance-carrier, but the identity keeps its shape over it)
interpretation: resonance crosses where friction stood. One quantity keeps two faces on both sides of the mirror. The shape keeps.
closing: The damping coefficient is pre-decided as carrying resistance, which could tempt a turn, but the rule states plainly that identities keep their shape, and the statement is explicitly an identity; no judgment call was required. This is one of the few reflections here that reads as more than a bare name, although 'fluctuation' itself had no partner.

physical: Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution width — The spread of molecular speeds in a gas grows with the square root of temperature and shrinks with the square root of molecular mass. σ_v ∝ √(k × T ÷ m). Form: equation.
reflected_formula: rise per Expansion ∝ √(k × T ÷ Movement M) (formula kept in the table's terms; k and T have no partner; the reading turns)
reflected_sentence: The formula is kept and the reading turns around: where the physical spread narrows as mass grows, rise per Expansion opens wider as Movement M stands in alignment — the warmth that pushes from the numerator has no partner and remains in plain words.
rule_reason: one limit caused by resistance: the spread shrinks as molecular mass grows, and inertial mass is pre-decided as opposition to change in motion; one resistance-cost is an odd count, so the reading turns around while the formula is kept
unmapped_terms: spread as a width (only velocity has a partner)
interpretation: Movement M reflected: as alignment grows, rise per Expansion opens wider. Temperature and the constant have no partner; that half of the relation stays silent.
closing: This was a judgment call, so forced is false. The costs field was empty, which by the letter of the even-count clause would mean keeps; but the statement itself says the spread shrinks with molecular mass, mass is pre-decided resistance, and a limit that tightens with resistance is exactly what the rule says turns. I counted that shrink-with-mass as one resistance-cost (odd) and turned the reading while keeping the formula. Reasonable strictness could also report keeps with confidence; log that as the live ambiguity.

The English echo of 'limitless' in a divergence was tempting, but the vocabulary supplies no partner for any term here, so there was nothing to hang a reflection on, and I refused to supply one.
